newsitem.title: USA: Seragen issues shares to Eli Lilly.
newsitem.headline: Seragen issues shares to Eli Lilly.

text.p: Seragen Inc said Wednesday that Eli Lilly and Co will help Seragen meet certain immediate financial obligations and will allow it to form additional partnerships.
The company said in exchange it will issue one million shares of its common stock in a private placement to Eli Lilly.
A Seragen spokeswoman said this financial obligation is "a specific significant payment that we have pending to a third party." She declined to provide more details.

The company said these steps are part of an amended aggrement with Eli Lilly, which has commited to develop, promote and distribute Seragen's lead molecule, Interleukin-2 Fusion Protein, a cancer treatment, as Seragen meets clinical, financial and manufacturing objectives.

The company said Eli Lilly, subject to certain limitations, has given up all other development and marketing rights to IL-2 Fusion Protein for non-cancer indications as well as rights to other Seragen molecules.
Seragen is a biopharmaceutical company developing anticancer and dermatology products.
